chain.label: Misaligned drilling of S-4L lap joint during 1996 manufacture
chain.trigger: during drilling of the S-4L lap joint, the crown skin panel and the upper left fuselage panel were misaligned, so most of the lower rivet row holes were misdrilled

chain.label: Boeing QA process did not catch the defective rivet installation on the crown skin panel
chain.trigger: the hole quality in the crown and left side skin panels was not in accordance with Boeing specifications or standard manufacturing practices and showed a lack of attention to detail and extremely poor manufacturing technique

chain.label: Latent manufacturing defect in S-4L lap joint (misdrilled, oversized, under-driven rivets) reduced fatigue life
chain.trigger: many of the installed rivets did not completely fill the holes in the lower skin panel, which significantly reduced the fatigue life of the panel

caused_by.evidence: misaligned...so most of the lower rivet row holes were misdrilled
hole quality...was not in accordance with Boeing specifications

chain.label: Fatigue cracking grew over the airplane's service life until the panel fractured and flapped open, causing rapid cabin decompression at FL340
chain.trigger: the cumulative amount of fatigue cracking reached a critical length, and the panel's residual strength was not sufficient to carry the loads, which resulted in the hole flapping open and rapid depressurization of the airplane

caused_by.evidence: fatigue cracking initiated at rivet hole 85...almost immediately after manufacture

chain.label: Flight attendant A attempted an interphone call/PA announcement before donning his oxygen mask
chain.trigger: he thought he "could get a lot more done" before getting his oxygen mask on

caused_by.evidence: Flight attendant A attempted to make either an interphone call or a P/A announcement to passengers...when he lost consciousness

chain.label: Flight attendant A lost consciousness, fell, and fractured his nose
chain.trigger: lost consciousness, fell, and struck his nose on the forward partition, sustaining a laceration and fracture

caused_by.evidence: leading to his loss of consciousness and fractured nose

chain.label: Employee passenger lost consciousness and fell while assisting flight attendant A, lacerating his eye
chain.trigger: the employee passenger lost consciousness and fell while attempting to assist flight attendant A. He sustained a laceration above his eye during the fall

chain.label: Flight crew conducted an emergency descent and diverted to Yuma, landing safely
chain.trigger: flight crew conducted an emergency descent and diverted to Yuma International Airport...landed about 1629 on runway 21R at NYL without further incident

caused_by.evidence: the flight crew conducted an emergency descent and diverted to Yuma International Airport
